notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
It is just the little things that I found.

 Improve UI for unspent Light Seals point, to make it more visible. 
 Fix exceptional stuck when jumping into the abyss spike.
 Fix visual bug for gaining additional Light Seals (100 Abyss Source = +1 Light Seal).

notes.title: Release info
notes.notes:
The game is complete, the last phase is the creation of achievements. I want to make game at 100% and deliver your as much finished and polished product as I can. So please be patient the Light Bringer will soon come to fight against the forces of the abyss and the endless darkness. Stay tuned!

See you this month in the world of Ifeon!

Jaroslav Šír
Mobiga Entertainment
